scope: Records, Workflow, Runtime and Files source/test foundation only. This is not owner closure, not a workflow promotion and not a claim of 41-owner or 206-workflow completion.

owners.limits: Raw source witnesses only. They do not grant request visibility, purchasing authority, replay or owner decisions. Commerce/Procurement native commands do not consume them yet.
owners.next: Mount the selected-request and request-link witnesses in the native Commerce/Procurement handoff before removing any TypeScript source. Registry list/search/paging and record writes remain retained.

owners.limits: The receipt source fence and count/record-origin evidence are source-only. Generic approval decisions, reroute, flow routing and the outbox consumer remain TypeScript authority.
owners.next: Mount the quality-return receipt fence in the native Quality return command with current IAM, purchase and same-unit effects. Port generic approval decision/reroute and flow routing before claiming the Workflow owner.

owners.limits: Validated roster data with pinned Node parity. It is not a sealed attestation, trusted process context, database identity grant or durable job runner.
owners.next: Bind the validated roster to the trusted Platform attestation and database identity path. A durable Rust outbox/job consumer and production worker registration are still required.

owners.limits: Pure target policy and PostgreSQL read/ancestry witnesses only. Upload, binding consumers, scanner worker, preview route and legacy TypeScript attachment paths are not certified by this bundle.
owners.next: Mount the Quality-hold policy in the Files attachment target policy, then wire the shared business-evidence adapter into a production owner command. Retain current IAM, scanner and target-authority guards.

notRun: No public gateway or Cloudflare change.
No authenticated browser journey or SSO cohort.
No full workspace clippy, Next production build or cross-owner journey gate for this bundle.

mapping.note: No owner or workflow is counted complete from this source-only bundle. The existing owner register remains the authority for the eight-owner scope.
